knowledge.title: Project knowledge
knowledge.description: Review and reuse project memory, specifications and skills as fixed revisions.
knowledge.empty_hint: Create a draft or extract source text from this project, then review and publish it for tasks.
knowledge.extraction_title: Extract a draft from project source
knowledge.extraction_hint: Extracts fixed source text without calling a model. Edit and review the draft; it is never published or executed automatically.
knowledge.manual_hint: Manual content is text context. A skill does not gain tool or command permissions.
knowledge.optional_title: Leave empty to use the source title
knowledge.source_quote_hint: Leave empty for the complete visible source; an excerpt must match the source version exactly.
knowledge.source_required: Choose a current source record from the loaded list.
knowledge.source_none: Manually authored; no source record is linked.
knowledge.source_outside: This result has no openable source in the current project.
knowledge.no_publication: Not published; unavailable for task selection.
knowledge.select_hint: Select an entry to inspect content, sources and eligibility.
knowledge.eligible.current: Sources current; eligible for new tasks
knowledge.changed_hint: Existing revisions and historical dispatches remain unchanged. Review sources and prepare a new draft before publishing again.
knowledge.publish_hint: Publishing creates an immutable revision for explicit task selection. Review the full content and sources. It starts no agent or command.
knowledge.retire_hint: Historical dispatches retain their fixed content. New dispatches cannot select this entry.
knowledge.review_confirm: I reviewed the complete content and sources of this revision
knowledge.approval_hint: Publishing and retirement require current server-verified approval permissions.
knowledge.known_current: Read current version and keep my draft
knowledge.dispatch.title: Project knowledge context (optional)
knowledge.dispatch.hint: Select published revisions with current sources. At most 16 items; the complete task context is limited to 32,000 UTF-8 bytes. Oversized context is rejected, never truncated.
knowledge.dispatch.unavailable: Currently unavailable; see its eligibility reason.
knowledge.dispatch.empty: No published project knowledge is available.
knowledge.dispatch.unknown: Current knowledge eligibility could not be read. Retry or explicitly clear the selection.
knowledge.errors.ineligible: The knowledge is unpublished, its source changed, or it belongs to another project. Refresh and select again.
knowledge.errors.selection_limit: Select at most 16 knowledge items without duplicate entries.
knowledge.errors.invalid_page: The project knowledge page is incomplete. Try again.
knowledge.eligible.publication_changed: A newer publication exists. Read the current version.
knowledge.refreshing_current: Reading the current official version before allowing more changes.
knowledge.source_adopt_hint: Adoption binds the complete current source text. Your knowledge content stays unchanged for editing; saving still requires another publication review.
knowledge.recovery_title: This project has an operation to recover. New writes are held.
knowledge.recovery_details: Inspect the original operation and submitted content
